reason: I'd probably try the free part for the research question and the framework diagram, but for everything else I'd just ask Claude, which I already pay for every month. My proposal is due in three weeks, so I don't need interview guides or transcript analysis yet, and I'm not paying $49 for things I can't use right now.
objection: I can't see what this does that a good prompt in ChatGPT or Claude doesn't. A curated library and verified citations sound nice, but I check citations myself anyway, and I'd be paying twice for AI.
would_change_my_mind: If the free framework turned out clearly better than what I get from ChatGPT, and my supervisor or another PhD student said the methodology chain actually held up, I'd pay when I get to fieldwork. Being able to pay for it from my research budget would make it easy.
